test_function_signatures: test that pybind11 bound functions expose correct Python signatures with type hints and defaults
test_named_arguments: test calling pybind11 functions with named keyword arguments and default values
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 functions that accept mixed positional args, *args, and **kwargs together
test_keyword_only_args: test pybind11 keyword-only argument bindings including defaults and error handling
test_positional_only_args: test pybind11 positional-only argument bindings and their interaction with keyword-only args
